header: Associate a data source with an OpenSearch UI application (console)
content:
To associate a data source with an OpenSearch UI application using the console
1.
Sign in to the Amazon OpenSearch Service console at https://console.aws.amazon.com/aos/
home.
2.
Choose OpenSearch UI (Dashboards), and then choose the name of an OpenSearch UI
application.
3.
In the Associated data sources area, choose Manage data sources.
4.
Choose from the OpenSearch domains and collections that you want to associate with the
application.
Tip
If you are not ﬁnding the data sources you are looking for, contact your administrators
to grant you the necessary permission. For more information, see the section called
“Permissions to create an application that uses IAM Identity Center authentication
(optional)”.
5.
Choose Next, and then choose Save.
After you have associated a data source with the application, the Launch Application button is
enabled on the application detail page. You can choose Launch Application to open the Welcome
to OpenSearch page, where you can create and manage workspaces.
For information about working with workspaces, see the section called “Using Amazon OpenSearch
Service workspaces”.
